Foreword to the Final Environmental Impact Statement for the City of San Jose's Community Development Block Grant Three Year Plan July 1978 - June 1981:
In accordance with the Environmental Review procedures as set forth in Section 58.17(f) of the July 16, 1975 Federal Register, the following errata, corrections, and response to comments combined with the "Draft" EIS constitute the "Final" Environmental Impact Statement for the Community Development Block Grant Project.
